_meta.why: The legacy app invented lawyer personas (names, ratings, case counts, phone numbers) and a fake news ticker. Both are gone. This file contains only official government / institutional pointers. Every URL has `status` because a stale link is a broken promise to a person in trouble.
_meta.rule: Never render a person's name or phone number that is not from an official source fetched at runtime. If a link 404s, the UI must say 'the directory moved - search for X' rather than guess.

legal_aid.name: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)
legal_aid.use: The body that runs free legal aid in India: eligibility rules, schemes, and links to every State Legal Services Authority.

legal_aid.name: NALSA e-Sewa / petition portal
legal_aid.use: Where available, apply for legal aid or move a petition online instead of visiting the office.

legal_aid.name: District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) at your District & Sessions Court
legal_aid.use: Search 'DLSA <your district>' or open your State Legal Services Authority page and pick the district. The DLSA secretary allots a free advocate and can exempt court fee.
legal_aid.note: Deliberately not a URL list - the correct office is always district-specific.

legal_aid.name: Supreme Court Legal Services Committee
legal_aid.use: Free legal aid for matters before the Supreme Court.

legal_aid.name: eCourts Services - case status, cause lists and orders
legal_aid.use: Track your own filed case, find the next hearing date and download orders. Most districts publish here.

legal_aid.name: Legal aid helpline numbers
legal_aid.use: Confirm the current number from nalsa.gov.in or your SLSA page before dialing; helpline numbers have changed over the years. Emergency: 112. Women: 181 / 1091. Cyber-financial fraud: 1930.
legal_aid.note: The app must not print a helpline number it has not verified on the official site today.

find_a_professional.name: State Bar Council (advocates enrolled in your state)
find_a_professional.use: The Bar Council of India page links every State Bar Council; enrolment details of an advocate can be checked there before you appoint them.
find_a_professional.note: Verifying that a lawyer is enrolled is the single most protective step for a first-time litigant.

find_a_professional.name: Advocate fee and appointment: what to insist on
find_a_professional.use: Get the fee in writing, ask for a copy of every filing within 24 hours, insist on the CMR/paperbook being maintained, and never pay only in cash without a receipt.

find_a_professional.name: Consumer commissions (file yourself - no lawyer needed)
find_a_professional.use: e-Daakhil allows a consumer to file in person; a lawyer is permitted but not required, which is why this route is often the cheapest for money claims.

find_a_professional.name: NCDRC (national consumer commission)
find_a_professional.use: Judgments, cause lists and practice directions of the National Commission.

record_sources.name: India Code - central acts and rules
record_sources.use: The authoritative text of every central Act. Cite from here, not from memory.

record_sources.name: Indian Kanoon - judgments
record_sources.use: Free full text of judgments; used to verify every precedent in this app.

record_sources.name: Supreme Court of India - judgments and orders
Central Information Commission
record_sources.use: Second-appeal decisions and the RTI annual reports.

record_sources.name: Legislative Department - Constitution and bills
record_sources.use: Constitution text, bills and enacted amendments.

record_sources.name: PRS India - legislative tracking
record_sources.use: Readable summaries of pending bills and committee reports; good for the 'what changed' section.

record_sources.name: Ministry of Consumer Affairs / National Consumer Helpline
record_sources.use: File a complaint and track it; also shows the CCPA's actions on misleading ads.

record_sources.name: MeitY / Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
record_sources.use: Report online financial fraud; the portal also handles prohibited-content complaints.

record_sources.name: RBI Banking Ombudsman (RB-IOS)
record_sources.use: Free escalation against banks and NBFCs.

record_sources.name: EPFO member portal
record_sources.use: PF passbook, UAN, and grievance redressal for PF defaults.

news_policy.removed: The legacy hardcoded 'news ticker' items were fabricated for the demo and have been deleted.
news_policy.current_behaviour: The app links out to primary sources (India Code, Indian Kanoon, PRS, the commissions' own judgment pages) instead of pretending to have a news feed.
news_policy.roadmap: Add a real, live feed by fetching the RSS of these sources server-side with a cache; every item must show the source and publication date. No AI-written 'news summaries' until a source URL exists.
